blocks.html: In all districts, as indicated, all permitted signs, other than advertising signs, for adult establishments shall conform with the provisions of this Chapter, except that the maximum surface area of all signs, other than advertising signs, for adult establishments shall not exceed, in the aggregate, three times the street frontage of the zoning lot, but in no event more than 150 square feet per establishment, of which no more than 50 square feet may be illuminated and no portion thereof may be flashing.
blocks.plainText: In all districts, as indicated, all permitted signs, other than advertising signs, for adult establishments shall conform with the provisions of this Chapter, except that the maximum surface area of all signs, other than advertising signs, for adult establishments shall not exceed, in the aggregate, three times the street frontage of the zoning lot, but in no event more than 150 square feet per establishment, of which no more than 50 square feet may be illuminated and no portion thereof may be flashing.

blocks.html: No signs for adult establishments shall be permitted on the roof of any building, nor shall such signs extend above curb level at a height greater than 25 feet.
blocks.plainText: No signs for adult establishments shall be permitted on the roof of any building, nor shall such signs extend above curb level at a height greater than 25 feet.
